meta.design: rolling-origin h=1；周度52点grid（47实测+5因果前向填充）；init=26；仅实测目标评估23折；月度各 16 点 init=10 → 6 折（事件窗口折仅 3 折）
meta.event_settings: oracle=same-period retrospective feature assumption; lag1=one-period event proxy; actual report publication timestamps unavailable
meta.event_feature_note: 72条gold事件+4条curated（移除与gold文档9/41重复的两条curated）；事件覆盖不完整，结果为描述性结果
meta.dir_acc_note: Tie-aware DirAcc; Naive is undefined/null because all predictions are ties; dir_n and dir_correct saved
meta.torch_device: cpu（3060 6GB 可用，但小模型 CPU 足够且可复现）
meta.preprocessing: causal_ffill; observed targets only; full weekly-grid exog
meta.legacy_interpolated_keys: Compatibility keys only: v4.2 lists forward-filled historical grid values, not interpolation
meta.neural_exog_alignment: target y_j uses rows [y_i,x_(i+1)] for i=j-8..j-1, identical fit/inference
meta.model_label_note: PatchTST key denotes a local patch Transformer, not the official PatchTST implementation

diagnostics.placebo: 事件日期随机置换，seed=[11, 22, 33] 取均值；保持事件数量与强度分布
diagnostics.ablation_ci: paired bootstrap 10000 次百分位 95% CI（delta=+Event − base 的逐折 MAE 差）
diagnostics.snaive_note: SNaive(4) 为周期 4 的季节朴素参照；序列太短无法识别真实季节周期，仅作稳健性参照

significance_tests.power_note: n=23; exploratory iid fold approximation; overlapping histories and multiple cells limit inference
